assessments.reasoning: GNU’s November 2002 edition at https://ftp.gnu.org/pub/gnu/Licenses/fdl-1.2.txt defines the listed passages at [3313,3591). The two paragraphs at [7003,8015) supply the medium, strict quantity threshold, notice condition, corresponding cover placement and overflow advice.

limitations: Whether a medium commonly has printed covers depends on the medium. The license’s sample notice does not establish the terms of an actual work. Publisher identification, title presentation and Opaque-copy duties are separate issues.
reasoning: Edition 1.2 includes printed copies and copies in media that commonly have printed covers. When publication exceeds 100 qualifying copies and the work’s authorized notice requires Cover Texts, the listed passages must appear clearly and legibly on the corresponding covers, subject to the accompanying overflow guidance.
